newsitem.title: GREECE: ROKAS OK'D FOR 2.0BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ROKAS OK'D FOR 2.0BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Greek metal construction Arcadia-Rokas got shareholder approval for a 2.024 billion drachma rights issue on Thursday.
The terms will be two new shares, either common or preferred, per 10 outstanding at 1,900 drachmas for common and 1,600 drachmas for preferred stock.
The ex-rights date will be announced at a later date, following the approval of the rights issue by the Athens bourse.
Proceeds from the rights issue will be used to finance capital investments on wind power projects carried out by 99 percent subsidiary Rokas Aeolian SA.
Currently, the company is constructing two wind power sites in Sitia, Crete and Evia.
Arcadia-Rokas expects to have revenues from the power sites in February 1998.
The company raised its 1996 dividend per share to 75 drachmas from 60 a year earlier.
The stock will trade ex-dividend June 20 while payment of dividends start in early July 1997.
Arcadia-Rokas forecast 1997 pretax earnings will exceed 1.25 billion drachmas, up 18.5 percent year-on-year.
Turnover is expected to improve 34.9 percent in 1997 and exceed 5.0 billion drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
